subject: Audit access: SSO extension request, conditional access notes, and bridge letter
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@apexaudit.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Wu <maria.wu@apexaudit.com>
Date: 2028-10-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: one-time SSO reissue + bridge letter for Oct audit window

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again — we're kicking off the on-site portion for Nimbus Health next week. Two quick items where we need Redwood's help before our review:

1) The one-time SSO link you provided last month expired before we could complete the session. Can you reissue a timeboxed SSO link for two auditors (Jordan Lee and Maria Wu) for a 48-hour window the week of Oct 22? We need read-only, no download, and IP-restricted sessions if possible.

2) There's a small coverage gap in your auditor evidence: our scope includes Sep 28–Oct 04 and your SOC 2 report indicates an overlap issue (audit agent logged out on Sep 30). For audit completeness our compliance lead is requesting a short "bridge letter" that confirms the controls in effect during Sep 28–Oct 04 and explains any temporary deviations (if any). A draft would be perfect — we can accept a Word doc we can annotate.

Also, could you provide a simple mapping (CSV) that lists who will be granted access and the exact portal activities they'll be able to perform? That helps our internal signoff.

Attachments requested: evidence export of retention-policy changes (if any), and an access matrix (CSV).

Happy to talk through on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Jordan
Apex Audit LLP

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@apexaudit.com>
Cc: Maria Wu <maria.wu@apexaudit.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time SSO reissue + bridge letter for Oct audit window

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. We can accommodate the two items; a couple of conditions so we stay aligned with our security posture:

- DPA requirement: we need a countersigned DPA (DocuSign link is fine) before provisioning portal access. Our legal team will accept Apex's standard form; please route the signed copy to security@redwood.com.
- Conditional access: we can set the session to read-only and apply IP restrictions. Please confirm the public IP ranges you'll use so we can allowlist them.
- Scope: we'll provide a 48-hour ephemeral session for both auditors with logging enabled and a no-download policy.

I've attached the access_matrix.csv template for you to fill in (columns: auditor_name,email,role,allowed_actions,ip_allowlist). Once we have the signed DPA and the IP ranges, I can generate the one-time SSO and provide a short-lived session link.

Regarding the bridge letter, I've started a draft and attached bridge_letter_draft.docx — it's intentionally terse and factual (dates, affected controls, and evidence references). If you need specific language for your reporting, flag the sections you'd like amended.

I'll send the SSO link as a separate secure note (we do not include active links inline in email).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bridge_letter_draft.docx (draft), access_matrix.csv (template)

Kimberly — great, thanks. A few quick points:

- IP ranges: see below — 35.197.12.0/24 (Apex HQ) and 18.209.45.0/24 (cloud lab). If you need narrower ranges we'll provide additional details.

We prefer to avoid long-lived sessions. Can the 48-hour window start 2028-10-22 09:00 PT? Maria and I will coordinate.

Once the DPA is posted I'll reply with the DocuSign URL. For your reference our audit lead is: Grace H. (grace.henderson@apexaudit.com).

Thanks —
Jordan
